cautions: Show source uses truthiness; empty array itself is truthy. Docs table as/asChild not present in ShowProps implementation.

pacing: Use completed reference work, batch related research and keep only material author-facing choices in the decision walk.

formatterDecision.selected: Numeric value property for both FormatNumber and FormatByte
formatterDecision.scope: Static HTML attributes convert to numeric property; dynamic Lit/React binding supplies raw number; child content is not an alternate data source.
formatterDecision.open: Exact formatting options/default locale, invalid/absent values, byte unit system and boundary behavior in inventory.

sidebarDecision.question: sidebar_responsive_scope
sidebarDecision.scope: Expanded, compact collapsed and small-screen Drawer presentations; preserve child state/focus; application owns routing/current page; exact breakpoints/widths later.

tocDecision.question: toc_heading_source
tocDecision.answer: I think it should support both.
tocDecision.scope: Support discovery from a specified content section and explicit curated entries. Real heading links and current-section tracking. Exact default/precedence/ID/heading-level/observer/history policies remain inventory work.

settingRowDecision.question: setting_row_disposition
settingRowDecision.scope: Remove Setting Row and Setting Rows; horizontal Field for input settings, Item+Button for actions, shared layout with semantic List/Fieldset where appropriate. Complete recipes preserve capabilities.

dataListDecision.question: data_list_replaces_description
dataListDecision.scope: Data List replaces Description for metadata label/value pairs, horizontal/vertical and rich values. Distinct from semantic List, Field and Stat.
dataListDecision.open: Exact parts/options; separate KV mapping still needs evaluation.

hoverCardBoundary: Requested Hover Card is included for supplementary previews; preserve existing explicit-activation decision for interactive rich help. Full surviving overlay interface mapping remains to resolve.
